<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="theme-color" content="#211525"/><title>Tiny: Left Unsupervised | Illustrated Stage 3</title><style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--gold:#ffd58e;--rose:#ed93b6;--ink:#27172a;--cream:#fff8e7;--green:#b2ffcb;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:#09090f;overflow:hidden;overscroll-behavior:none}body{display:grid;place-items:center}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b9fff1;outline-offset:2px}.hidden{display:none!important}
#game{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;width:min(100vw,177.7778dvh);height:min(100dvh,56.25vw);background:#241c27;border:clamp(2px,.35vw,5px) solid #c99373;border-radius:clamp(9px,1.4vw,22px);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 36px #050408}
#game:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px solid #ffe8bd7a;pointer-events:none;border-radius:inherit;z-index:45}
#hud{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:10%;z-index:30;background:linear-gradient(#221428f3,#30202fe8);border-bottom:2px solid #eebc8799;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8%;padding:0 1%;color:#ffe5b9;font-weight:950;white-space:nowrap}
#brand{font:900 clamp(12px,1.45vw,23px)/1 Georgia,serif;max-width:41%;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}.pill{border:1.8px solid #cfa2b5aa;border-radius:13px;background:#4a2d46a8;padding:.5% .8%;font-size:clamp(9px,1.18vw,18px)}#energy{font-size:clamp(9px,1.1vw,18px)}#energyTrack{width:9%;height:16%;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid #d2a0a0;background:#1e1526;overflow:hidden}#energyFill{display:block;height:100%;width:36%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ee70a9,#ffe1bc)}.spacer{flex:1}.icon{background:#463148a6;color:#fff;border:2px solid #baa1c0;border-radius:11px;min-width:4.2%;height:80%;font-size:clamp(13px,1.6vw,25px);padding:0 4px;font-weight:900}
#scene{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:10%;bottom:25%;background:linear-gradient(#17171c18,#210e1d24),url('data:image/webp;base64,') center center/cover no-repeat;overflow:hidden}
#scene:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#111e2200 35%,#21121e7a 100%);pointer-events:none}
#stageFlag{position:absolute;left:1.2%;top:1.4%;z-index:7;border-radius:14px;background:#2c1d30e8;border:1px solid #b48d78bf;color:#fff4dc;padding:.5% 1.4%;font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(11px,1.35vw,21px);pointer-events:none}
#tiny{position:absolute;z-index:6;left:2%;bottom:-5%;height:84%;width:23%;object-fit:contain;object-position:bottom;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 12px #20111acc);transition:transform .35s,opacity .35s}
#sea{position:absolute;z-index:6;right:2%;bottom:-7%;height:89%;width:23%;object-fit:contain;object-position:bottom;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 12px #011810d6);transition:transform .35s,opacity .35s}
#scene.playing #tiny{transform:translateX(-24%) scale(.78);opacity:.82}#scene.playing #sea{transform:translateX(25%) scale(.78);opacity:.72}
#scene.bonk #tiny{animation:bonk .55s ease-in-out}#scene.win #tiny{animation:cheer .55s ease-in-out}
@keyframes bonk{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}27%{transform:rotate(-14deg) translateY(8px)}60%{transform:rotate(10deg) translateY(-4px)}}@keyframes cheer{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}40%{transform:translateY(-15px) rotate(-4deg)}}
#speech{position:absolute;z-index:10;top:11%;left:27%;width:44%;min-height:22%;max-height:47%;padding:1% 2.5%;border:3px solid #59364b;border-radius:20px;background:#fff9e6;box-shadow:0 7px 0 #271a31ba;color:#362233;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:2px;overflow:visible;line-height:1.18;word-break:normal;overflow-wrap:break-word}
#speech .speaker{display:block;color:#ad5477;font-size:clamp(9px,1.08vw,16px);font-weight:950;line-height:1.12;flex:none}
#speechText{display:block;font-size:clamp(11px,1.45vw,21px);font-weight:850;line-height:1.16;max-width:100%;padding:0 .4em .06em}
#speech:after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-11px;width:20px;height:20px;border-right:3px solid #59364b;border-bottom:3px solid #59364b;transform:rotate(45deg);background:#fff9e6}#speech.from-tiny:after{left:17%}#speech.from-sea:after{right:16%}
#scene.playing #speech{display:none}
#guestChip{position:absolute;z-index:9;right:1.7%;top:6%;background:#38263bdc;color:#fdf3e0;border:1.5px solid #cfa680;border-radius:15px;padding:1% 1.1%;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,16px);max-width:26%;text-align:center;display:none}#guestChip b{display:block;font-size:1.15em;color:#ffd891}#guestChip.show{display:block}
/* The playfield is laid over an illustrated enchanted-enclosure, without obscuring its scene completely. */
#netBoard{position:absolute;z-index:12;left:23%;top:8%;width:55%;height:83%;border:3px solid #e2b987;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(165deg,#283d3bdd,#34243ace);box-shadow:0 9px 22px #170e20d9,inset 0 2px 16px #eacf9140;display:none;padding:1.2% 1.5% 1.1%;flex-direction:column;gap:1.2%}
#netBoard.show{display:flex}#boardTop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:2%;color:#fff7e6;font-size:clamp(9px,1.05vw,15px);font-weight:950;height:13%}
#boardTop strong{color:#b8ffe2}#boardTimer{font-size:1.22em;color:#ffe6a8}
#holeGrid{height:86%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1.5%;touch-action:manipulation}
.hole{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;padding:0;border:1.5px solid #d9be8a80;border-radius:12px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 48% 33% at 50% 76%,#070b10 8%,#251b1e 57%,transparent 69%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 35% 13%,#7d704859,#2b382966);touch-action:manipulation;user-select:none;cursor:pointer}
.hole:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:8%;right:8%;bottom:12%;height:24%;border:2px solid #8e6e43a6;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(#4d39253d,#22160c28);pointer-events:none}
.hole:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:5%;right:5%;bottom:3%;height:13%;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(#755835,#a0784c 45%,#59412b);border:1px solid #edbd7471;box-shadow:0 2px 2px #0006;pointer-events:none;z-index:5}
.raccoon{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:50%;bottom:5%;height:96%;width:min(85%,92px);transform:translate(-50%,100%);transition:transform .19s ease-out;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px #090f16)}.hole.active .raccoon{transform:translate(-50%,0)}.raccoon svg{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;overflow:visible}
.raccoon.key{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #ffe268)}.key-icon{position:absolute;right:1%;top:-4%;font-size:clamp(14px,2.3vw,33px);transform:rotate(-18deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 2px #2d1a0f)}
.hat{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:50%;bottom:11%;font-size:clamp(27px,4.2vw,58px);transform:translate(-50%,100%);transition:transform .16s ease;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 3px #190d14)}.hole.active .hat{transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.net-impact{position:absolute;z-index:9;top:5%;left:50%;width:clamp(29px,5vw,78px);height:clamp(29px,5vw,78px);transform:translate(-50%,-10%);pointer-events:none;animation:netSwipe .32s ease forwards}.net-impact svg{width:100%;height:100%}
@keyframes netSwipe{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-55%) rotate(-48deg) scale(1.25)}40%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,3%) rotate(-5deg)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-6%) rotate(12deg)}}
#countdown{position:absolute;z-index:17;left:24%;top:14%;width:53%;height:71%;border-radius:16px;border:3px solid #eec58a;background:#201a31e5;color:#ffe8be;font-size:clamp(44px,7.2vw,105px);font-weight:1000;text-shadow:0 5px 0 #452034,0 0 16px #ffd6aa;display:none;place-items:center;pointer-events:none}#countdown.show{display:grid}#countdown.go{background:#185c4be8;color:#d0ffdf}
#flash{position:absolute;z-index:28;top:20%;left:26%;width:48%;padding:2%;text-align:center;border-radius:18px;border:3px solid #ffe1a3;background:#3d253ae9;color:#fff3d2;font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(15px,2.3vw,31px);pointer-events:none;display:none;box-shadow:0 7px 15px #100a14ad}#flash.show{display:block;animation:flashIn .42s ease-out}@keyframes flashIn{from{transform:scale(.76);opacity:0}35%{transform:scale(1.04);opacity:1}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
#bottom{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:25%;z-index:25;border-top:4px solid #e0ad7c;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#301b32,#211627);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1%;padding:1% 1.3%;color:#fff2da}
#copy{width:43%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:.1em}#kicker{color:#f4abcf;font-size:clamp(9px,1.2vw,18px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.02em}#heading{color:#ffdea6;font:900 clamp(18px,2.1vw,31px)/1.05 Georgia,serif}#story{color:#fff3ec;font-size:clamp(10px,1.15vw,17px);line-height:1.2;max-height:41%;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:none}#story::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#actions{width:56%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1.1%;flex-wrap:wrap}.btn{min-height:43%;flex:1 1 30%;border:2px solid #ffeaac;border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(#ffe3a1,#cc8b4c);color:#472e35;font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(10px,1.15vw,17px);padding:1% 1.5%;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #482e3f;line-height:1.1;white-space:normal}.btn.secondary{background:linear-gradient(#f3a7c9,#bb5589)}.btn:disabled{opacity:.52}.btn:active{transform:translateY(2px)}
#powers{position:absolute;z-index:21;bottom:26%;left:1%;width:35%;display:none;gap:1.5%;pointer-events:auto}#powers.show{display:flex}#powers button{flex:1;min-width:0;border:1.4px solid #f4cba2;border-radius:11px;background:#2d2032e5;color:#fff1d6;font-size:clamp(8px,.99vw,14px);font-weight:900;padding:.7% .2%;line-height:1.15}
#guide{position:absolute;z-index:42;inset:14% 21%;padding:3%;border:3px solid #ffda98;border-radius:20px;background:#2b2035f7;box-shadow:0 0 0 120vmax #120d179e;text-align:center;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;gap:1%;color:#fff4e6}#guide.show{display:flex}#guide h2{margin:0;color:#ffe0a1;font-size:clamp(16px,2.6vw,34px)}#guide p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(11px,1.25vw,19px);line-height:1.35}#guide button{padding:.6% 4%;font-size:clamp(11px,1.5vw,21px)}#closeGuide{position:absolute;right:1.5%;top:2%;font-size:20px;border:1px solid #fff3;border-radius:10px;color:#fff;background:#423147;z-index:43}
#toast{position:absolute;z-index:35;top:10.5%;left:30%;max-width:44%;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid #fef6df;background:#c2ffe7;color:#244538;font-size:clamp(10px,1.2vw,18px);padding:.6% 1.1%;font-weight:900;display:none;text-align:center;pointer-events:none}
#report{position:absolute;z-index:32;top:17%;left:27%;width:46%;border:3px solid #f5cd86;border-radius:19px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#3d2941f7,#26192bf8);padding:2% 3%;color:#ffeec9;box-shadow:0 12px 25px #120b17bb;text-align:center;display:none;font-size:clamp(10px,1.25vw,18px)}#report.show{display:block}#report h2{font-size:clamp(18px,2.5vw,34px);margin:.1em 0 .4em;color:#fff0b9}#report p{margin:.45em 0;line-height:1.35}#report strong{color:#a9f7c5}
@media(max-height:420px){#brand{max-width:34%;font-size:clamp(11px,1.35vw,20px)}#speech{top:9%;min-height:23%;max-height:51%}#speechText{font-size:clamp(10px,1.35vw,18px)}#guestChip{display:none!important}#netBoard{left:23%;width:55%;top:6%;height:87%}#countdown{top:13%;height:73%}#copy{width:40%}#actions{width:59%}#story{max-height:36%}#holeGrid{gap:1%}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.raccoon,.hat,.net-impact,#scene.bonk #tiny,#scene.win #tiny{animation:none;transition:none}}

/* v2: No triangular speech tails. They were obscuring the last words on mobile. */
#speech::after, #speech:after, #speech.from-tiny::after, #speech.from-sea::after,
#speech.from-catalyst::after, #speech.from-mo::after, #speech.from-savvy::after {
  content:none!important;display:none!important;width:0!important;height:0!important;
}
#speech{left:26%;width:47%;top:10%;max-height:none;min-height:23%;padding:1.2% 2.6%;
  border-radius:16px;overflow:visible;z-index:13;box-sizing:border-box}
#speech .speaker{width:100%;font-size:clamp(10px,1.09vw,16px)}
#speechText{width:100%;max-width:100%;padding:0 .4em .2em;box-sizing:border-box;
  font-size:clamp(11px,1.37vw,19px);line-height:1.22;overflow:visible;overflow-wrap:normal}
#speech.from-sea{left:28%;width:46%}
#speech.from-catalyst{left:26%;width:47%}
#guestChip{display:none!important} /* No redundant bubble overlapping the dialogue or characters */
#sea.catalyst{right:1.8%;width:23%;height:85%;bottom:-6%;filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 11px #1d1628b8)}
@media(max-width:850px){
  #speech{top:9%;left:25%;width:48%;min-height:24%;padding:1.4% 3%}
  #speech.from-sea,#speech.from-catalyst{left:25%;width:48%}
  #speechText{font-size:clamp(10px,1.31vw,15px);line-height:1.22}
}


/* Stage 3 v3: illustrated Mo, nonblocking key cue and Baba pop-up decoy */
#sea.mo{height:85%;width:23%;right:1.5%;bottom:-5%;object-position:bottom;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 11px #251628a6)}
#speech:after,#speech::after{content:none!important;display:none!important}
#keyCue{display:none;border-radius:99px;padding:1px 6px;background:#ffe5a0;color:#372737;font-size:clamp(8px,.84vw,12px);font-weight:1000;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #dca96388;animation:keyShimmer .8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#keyCue.show{display:inline-block}
#boardTop{gap:1%;font-size:clamp(8px,.94vw,14px)}
@keyframes keyShimmer{from{background:#ffe5a0}to{background:#f8f5cf}}
/* Always keep notifications outside the interactive center of the nine holes. */
#scene.playing #flash{left:1.1%;top:42%;width:20.5%;font-size:clamp(9px,1.3vw,18px);padding:.8%;line-height:1.12;z-index:12;max-height:26%}
.baba-pop{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-4%;height:107%;width:82%;z-index:4;transform:translate(-50%,105%);transition:transform .18s ease;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px #201528)}
.hole.active .baba-pop{transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.baba-pop img{height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:50% 100%}
@media(max-width:850px){#keyCue{font-size:8px;padding:1px 3px}#boardTop{gap:.6%;font-size:8px}#sea.mo{width:22%;height:85%;bottom:-6%}}


/* v3: separate the final raccoon report from Tiny's speech bubble */
#report{top:43%!important;left:23%!important;width:54%!important;max-height:55%!important;
  overflow:auto!important;padding:1.1% 1.8%!important;border-radius:16px!important;}
#report h2{font-size:clamp(15px,1.85vw,28px)!important;line-height:1.08!important;margin:0 0 .2em!important}
#report p{font-size:clamp(10px,1.14vw,17px)!important;line-height:1.24!important;margin:.1em 0!important}
#speech{max-height:35%!important;min-height:22%!important;top:8%!important;font-size:clamp(11px,1.2vw,16px)!important;}
#speechText{font-size:clamp(10px,1.23vw,17px)!important;line-height:1.18!important}
</style></head><body>
<div id="game" role="main" aria-label="Illustrated Stage 3 Release the Raccoons">
<header id="hud"><span id="brand">🎀 TINY LEFT UNSUPERVISED</span><span class="pill">STAGE 3</span><span class="pill">CHAOS <span id="chaos">0</span></span><span id="energy">⚡ 35/100</span><span id="energyTrack"><i id="energyFill"></i></span><span class="spacer"></span><button id="help" class="icon" title="Help" aria-label="Help">?</button><button id="pause" class="icon" title="Pause" aria-label="Pause">Ⅱ</button><button id="music" class="icon" title="Sound" aria-label="Toggle sound">♫</button><button id="full" class="icon" title="Fullscreen" aria-label="Fullscreen">⛶</button></header>
<section id="scene" aria-label="The royal raccoon enclosure"><div id="stageFlag">🦝 THE GREAT RACCOON ESCAPE</div>
<img id="tiny" src="data:image/webp;base64,
